sections.title: Day 8 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
第一週完成後，今天正式進入第二週。主題是 **分詞：V-ing vs. V-ed**。這是 TOEIC Part 5 很常見的高頻考點，也是從基礎題走向 860+ 題型的重要一步。

由於目前沒有收到 Day 7 週測的實際答題結果，今天維持 **860+ 難度**，但開始增加容易混淆的選項。建議訓練 **90～110 分鐘**。

## ① 今日高頻單字 30 個

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜V-ing vs. V-ed
sections.markdown:
先比較：

> The presentation was **boring**.

和：

> The employees were **bored**.

兩個都來自：

**bore**

但意思完全不同。

**boring** → 造成某種感覺

**bored** → 感受到某種感覺

所以：

> The presentation is boring.

簡報讓人無聊。

> The employees are bored.

員工感到無聊。

這就是今天第一個核心。

---

## TOEIC 超高頻組合

| V-ing | V-ed |
|---|---|
| interesting | interested |
| exciting | excited |
| surprising | surprised |
| satisfying | satisfied |
| disappointing | disappointed |
| confusing | confused |
| encouraging | encouraged |
| pleasing | pleased |

判斷時不要背「物用 ing、人用 ed」這種過度簡化規則。

真正應該問：

> **主詞是在造成感覺，還是感受到感覺？**

例如：

> The results were **surprising**.

結果「令人驚訝」。

而：

> The manager was **surprised** by the results.

主管「感到驚訝」。

---

sections.title: ③ 第二種分詞考法：修飾名詞
sections.markdown:
TOEIC 不只考情緒。

例如：

> a _____ company

(A) grow  
(B) growing  
(C) grown  
(D) growth

**growing company**

= 正在成長的公司。

答案：

**B**

再看：

> _____ equipment

(A) damage  
(B) damaging  
(C) damaged  
(D) damages

如果意思是：

「受損的設備」

就是：

> **damaged equipment**

答案：

**C**

所以可以先建立：

**V-ing → 主動／進行**

**V-ed → 被動／完成**

---

sections.title: ④ 860+ 分詞陷阱
sections.markdown:
### Example 1

> Customers were _____ with the improved service.

(A) satisfy  
(B) satisfying  
(C) satisfied  
(D) satisfaction

customers 感到滿意。

答案：

**C**

---

### Example 2

> The company reported _____ sales figures.

(A) encourage  
(B) encouraging  
(C) encouraged  
(D) encouragement

sales figures 讓人受到鼓舞。

所以：

> **encouraging sales figures**

答案：

**B**

---

### Example 3

> Please return all _____ products to the manufacturer.

(A) defect  
(B) defective  
(C) defectively  
(D) defects

這題不是分詞，而是混入詞性陷阱。

需要修飾：

> products

所以：

**形容詞 defective**

答案：

**B**

這就是第二週開始會出現的題型：

> 你以為正在考分詞，但其實是在考詞性。

因此仍然要遵守：

**先看結構，不要猜考點。**

---

sections.title: ⑤ Listening｜Part 2 860+ 間接回答
sections.markdown:
今天提高一級。

### Q1

> Aren't you attending the budget meeting?

(A) It was moved to tomorrow.  
(B) About $50,000.  
(C) In the accounting office.

答案：

**A**

不要被：

budget → $50,000

這種相同主題字騙走。

---

### Q2

> Who prepared the quarterly report?

(A) I believe Sarah handled it.  
(B) About twenty pages.  
(C) Last Thursday.

答案：

**A**

handled it = 負責處理。

---

### Q3

> Why hasn't the invoice been paid?

(A) Accounting is still reviewing it.  
(B) Approximately $800.  
(C) On Mr. Chen's desk.

答案：

**A**

沒有直接出現 because，但語意就是原因。

---

### Q4

> Would you like me to calculate the total?

(A) That would be helpful.  
(B) About $3,000.  
(C) The annual report.

答案：

**A**

Would you like me to...?

= 主動提出協助。

---

### Q5

> Didn't Kevin submit the expense report?

(A) He was waiting for a receipt.  
(B) About five expenses.  
(C) To the finance department.

答案：

**A**

這題需要推論：

還在等 receipt → 很可能還沒 submit。

---

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Part 7
sections.markdown:
今天限時 **3 分鐘**。

> **From:** Accounting Department  
> **To:** Department Managers  
> **Subject:** Expense Report Deadline
>
> All expense reports for business travel completed during August must be submitted to the Accounting Department by September 12.
>
> Employees should attach receipts for transportation, accommodation, meals, and other approved business expenses. Reports submitted without the required documentation may take longer to process.
>
> Managers are responsible for reviewing each report before it is sent to Accounting. Once a report has been approved, reimbursement will normally be deposited into the employee's bank account within five business days.
>
> Employees with questions about eligible expenses should consult the updated travel expense policy available on the company intranet.

### Q1

Who is the email primarily intended for?

(A) Customers  
(B) Department managers  
(C) Job applicants  
(D) Suppliers

### Q2

What must employees include with their expense reports?

(A) Bank statements  
(B) Travel schedules  
(C) Receipts  
(D) Employment contracts

### Q3

What could delay processing?

(A) Missing documentation  
(B) Overseas travel  
(C) Manager approval  
(D) Bank transactions

### Q4

What happens before a report is sent to Accounting?

(A) An employee receives reimbursement  
(B) A manager reviews it  
(C) A bank verifies it  
(D) A supplier approves it

### Q5

How will employees normally receive reimbursement?

(A) By check  
(B) In cash  
(C) Through a bank deposit  
(D) Through their manager

### Q6

Where can employees learn which expenses are eligible?

(A) Company intranet  
(B) Accounting office  
(C) Bank website  
(D) Conference room

答案：

**1B / 2C / 3A / 4B / 5C / 6A**

今天 Part 7 要注意同義替換：

文章：

> documentation

題目可能變成：

> required documents

文章：

> deposited into the employee's bank account

答案：

> through a bank deposit

正式 TOEIC 很少永遠把答案原字照抄。

---

sections.title: ⑦ Part 5 仿真題｜12 題
sections.markdown:
限制 **4 分鐘**。

### 1

Customers were _____ with the company's new refund policy.

(A) satisfy  
(B) satisfying  
(C) satisfied  
(D) satisfaction

### 2

The company reported _____ financial results this quarter.

(A) encourage  
(B) encouraging  
(C) encouraged  
(D) encouragement

### 3

Please replace any _____ equipment immediately.

(A) damage  
(B) damaging  
(C) damaged  
(D) damages

### 4

The seminar was both informative and _____.

(A) interest  
(B) interested  
(C) interesting  
(D) interestingly

### 5

Employees were _____ to hear about the additional benefits.

(A) please  
(B) pleased  
(C) pleasing  
(D) pleasure

### 6

The rapidly _____ company plans to hire another fifty employees.

(A) grow  
(B) growing  
(C) grown  
(D) growth

### 7

The manager found the sales figures _____.

(A) disappoint  
(B) disappointed  
(C) disappointing  
(D) disappointment

### 8

The _____ customers were offered a full refund.

(A) dissatisfy  
(B) dissatisfied  
(C) dissatisfying  
(D) dissatisfaction

### 9

The accounting department is reviewing all _____ invoices.

(A) outstanding  
(B) outstandingly  
(C) withstand  
(D) stood

### 10

The company introduced an _____ training program.

(A) improve  
(B) improving  
(C) improved  
(D) improvement

### 11

The announcement contained some _____ information.

(A) surprise  
(B) surprised  
(C) surprising  
(D) surprisingly

### 12

Several employees seemed _____ about the new policy.

(A) confuse  
(B) confusing  
(C) confused  
(D) confusion

答案：

**1C / 2B / 3C / 4C / 5B / 6B / 7C / 8B / 9A / 10C / 11C / 12C**

注意 Q10：

> an **improved** training program

意思是：

**經過改善的訓練計畫**

program 接受 improve，因此用 V-ed。

---

sections.title: ⑨ 解析與錯題診斷
sections.markdown:
今天最重要的是前五題。

如果 Q1、Q5 錯：

標記：

**G — 感受者 V-ed**

> customers were surprised

> employees were confused

如果 Q2、Q4 錯：

標記：

**G — 造成感覺 V-ing**

> encouraging results

> interesting presentation

如果 Q3 錯：

標記：

**G — 被動分詞**

> damaged products

產品「被損壞」。

如果 Q6～Q9 錯比較多：

問題可能不在文法，而是：

**L/TR — Part 2 還在找問題裡相同的單字，而不是理解回答。**

---

sections.title: ⑩ 第一週錯題複習
sections.markdown:
今天仍要保留之前學過的結構。

看到：

> The company _____ three branches since January.

先想到：

**since → has opened**

看到：

> The equipment _____ yesterday.

想到：

**yesterday + 被動 → was inspected**

看到：

> Management considered _____ the office.

想到：

**consider + V-ing**

看到：

> We look forward to _____ from you.

想到：

**look forward to + V-ing**

看到：

> All applications must _____.

想到：

**must be submitted**

第二週開始，這些不能每次重新分析很久，而要逐漸變成自動反射。

---

sections.title: ⑪ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天先複習 30 個財務單字，尤其要直接認得：

> account balance  
> make a deposit  
> service charge  
> outstanding balance  
> overdue payment  
> annual budget  
> quarterly earnings  
> generate a profit

接著做一個「分詞口頭訓練」。

看到：

**interest**

立刻說：

> The presentation is **interesting**.

> I am **interested** in the presentation.

看到：

**surprise**

說：

> The results are **surprising**.

> The manager is **surprised**.

看到：

**confuse**

說：

> The instructions are **confusing**.

> The customers are **confused**.

最後重新完成今日 10 題小考，第二次限制 **3 分鐘**，目標 **10/10**。

今天開始，正確率之外也要追蹤速度。如果能做到 **9～10 題正確且 3 分鐘左右完成**，代表 Part 5 基礎已經可以開始往更高強度推進。

**Day 8 核心：V-ing 偏向「造成／進行」，V-ed 偏向「感受／被動／完成」；但最後仍以句子真正的主被動關係為準。**

Day 9 將進入 **關係代名詞 who / which / that / whose**，並開始訓練「先找缺少的句子成分再選關代」，這會比單純背 who=人、which=物更接近 TOEIC 860+ 的解題方式。

questions.prompt: Customers were _____ with the company's new refund policy.
questions.explanation: customers 是感受者，使用 V-ed 形容詞 satisfied。

questions.prompt: The company reported _____ financial results this quarter.
questions.explanation: results 造成鼓舞的感覺，使用 V-ing 形容詞 encouraging。

questions.prompt: Please replace any _____ equipment immediately.
questions.explanation: equipment 被損壞，使用過去分詞 damaged。

questions.prompt: The seminar was both informative and _____.
questions.explanation: seminar 令人感興趣，使用 interesting。

questions.prompt: Employees were _____ to hear about the additional benefits.
questions.explanation: employees 是感受者，使用 pleased。

questions.prompt: The rapidly _____ company plans to hire another fifty employees.
questions.explanation: company 正在成長，使用 growing。

questions.prompt: The manager found the sales figures _____.
questions.explanation: sales figures 令人失望，使用 disappointing。

questions.prompt: The _____ customers were offered a full refund.
questions.explanation: customers 感到不滿，使用 dissatisfied。

questions.prompt: The accounting department is reviewing all _____ invoices.
questions.explanation: outstanding invoices 是「未支付的發票」的固定搭配。

questions.prompt: The company introduced an _____ training program.
questions.explanation: program 經過改善，使用過去分詞 improved。

questions.prompt: The announcement contained some _____ information.
questions.explanation: information 令人驚訝，使用 surprising。

questions.prompt: Several employees seemed _____ about the new policy.
questions.explanation: employees 感到困惑，使用 confused。

questions.prompt: The customers were _____ by the unexpected service charge.
questions.explanation: customers 是感受者，使用 surprised。

questions.prompt: The company announced _____ sales results.
questions.explanation: sales results 令人受到鼓舞，使用 encouraging。

questions.prompt: All _____ products should be returned immediately.
questions.explanation: products 被損壞，使用 damaged。

questions.prompt: The presentation was extremely _____.
questions.explanation: presentation 令人感興趣，使用 interesting。

questions.prompt: Employees appeared _____ about the schedule change.
questions.explanation: employees 感到困惑，使用 confused。

questions.prompt: Why hasn't the invoice been processed?
questions.explanation: Accounting is still reviewing it 說明尚未處理的原因。

questions.prompt: Who's preparing the financial report?

options.A: I think Jessica is handling it.

questions.explanation: Jessica is handling it 是 Who 問句的合理回答。

questions.prompt: Would you like me to calculate the expenses?
questions.explanation: That would help 接受對方主動提出的協助。

questions.prompt: Didn't David submit his reimbursement request?

options.A: He was still looking for a receipt.

questions.explanation: 仍在找收據，表示很可能尚未提交申請。

questions.prompt: A payment described as **overdue** is:

options.B: not paid by the required date

questions.explanation: overdue 表示超過規定日期仍未付款。

keyTakeaway: V-ing 偏向造成／進行；V-ed 偏向感受／被動／完成，最後仍以句子的主被動關係為準。
